title: Matched two-dimensional pristine-defect extraction exercise
status_detail: Third manuscript impurity warmup in planning. No two-dimensional planted-defect extraction, alignment, finite-size study, reduced model, or observable result has been produced or accepted.
objective: Extend matched pristine-defect extraction to the controlled two-dimensional periodic model, adding degeneracy, directional locality, gauge-loop, symmetry, and anisotropic observable controls.
authorized_scope: Plan null and planted two-dimensional defect operators in explicitly matched retained spaces.
Exercise degenerate-subspace alignment, symmetry channels, spatial-shell residuals, finite supercell scaling, anisotropic localization, and local-versus-nonlocal model classes.
Carry forward exact controls from the one-dimensional defect and two-dimensional periodic exercises before adding genuinely two-dimensional complications.
completion_criteria: Known null and planted defects are recovered or fail through explicit alignment, conditioning, finite-size, and model-class diagnostics.
Operator, projector, spectral, bound-state, wavefunction, spatial, symmetry, and anisotropy metrics remain separately interpreted.
The result documents which abstractions recur across the exercise program without freezing them as a production scientific API.
exclusions: No material-specific impurity, DFT or production Wannier calculation, transferability claim, scientific validation, or public API freeze is authorized.
A small global norm is not treated as excluding a localized or symmetry-specific failure.
Completion does not activate the bulk-silicon or doped-silicon production programs.
